create.name: Teresa Blythe
create.bio:
Teresa Blythe is a spiritual director, trainer and writer based in Phoenix, Arizona, and an ordained minister of the United Church of Christ. She worked as a radio news journalist before going to San Francisco Theological Seminary, graduating in 2000 with a Master of Divinity and a seminary diploma in spiritual direction. For around fourteen years she directed the Hesychia School of Spiritual Direction near Tucson, training hundreds of new directors, and after settling in Phoenix she set up the Phoenix Center for Spiritual Direction, based at the First UCC church downtown.

Her approach is contemplative Christian but open to many faiths, and she follows the evocative method: listening closely, offering no fixes and helping people notice for themselves where the sacred is moving in their lives. Her practice is explicitly affirming of LGBTQ people. She meets individuals by Zoom or phone, guides groups and organisations, facilitates discernment through clearness committees, offers supervision to working directors, and runs a one-to-one online apprentice programme for people training to become spiritual directors. Her books include 50 Ways to Pray, a collection of prayer practices from many traditions, and Spiritual Direction 101, a primer on the basics of spiritual guidance.

videos.title: Developing Spiritual Awareness through Meditation and Prayer

courses.title: Individual Spiritual Direction
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by Zoom or phone in which she listens without judgement and helps people reflect on their spiritual path. A sliding scale is available on request.

courses.title: Group Spiritual Direction
courses.description: Spiritual direction for a group of three or more who meet together, sharing their stories and listening to one another's paths. Arrangements are agreed with each group.

courses.title: Discernment Coaching
courses.description: Help with a significant life or vocational choice, one to one or through a Quaker-style clearness committee; she also works with boards and leadership teams.

courses.title: Supervision for Spiritual Directors
courses.description: Forty-five-minute online or phone sessions for practising directors, working from a written reflection on a session to look at what is arising in the director.

courses.title: Apprentice Training Program for Spiritual Directors
courses.description: A one-to-one online training of at least nine months for spiritually mature applicants, with thirty hours of teaching and mentoring and twelve supervised sessions with a directee. Applicants need a year in spiritual direction and a reference.

free_resources.title: Teresa Blythe on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free guided prayers and contemplative meditations on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Spiritual Direction: A Guide for Seekers
free_resources.description: A short free ebook on what spiritual direction involves and how to find a director who suits you.

free_resources.title: Prayer Practices from 50 Ways to Pray
free_resources.description: A free PDF of prayer practices taken from her book, ready to use alone or with a group.
